notes.title: CROSSING GUARD JOE
notes.content:
September Games is proud to announce: Crossing Guard Joe.

[previewyoutube=CeQZaVoXaNk;full][/previewyoutube]

In this action arcade game, Joe must battle the combined forces of angry motorists and bureaucratic red tape while trying to shepard kids across the deadly crosswalks of Monoxide City.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849284/fd9250d885b67b9bbd800a26121b834d3ff536f0.gif[/img]

The gameplay requires hands-on action and quick thinking. The drivers of Monoxide City have no respect for traffic laws, pedestrians, common decency, or YOU. They won't stop for anything so you'll need to be quick on your feet and able to make snap-decisions to safely shepard all the kids across the street. The easy-to-learn 4-button control scheme is intuitive even to casual players, but the challenge of the levels ramp up steadily. Easy to pick up, hard to master. Besides angry motorists you'll also have to contend with the bureaucrats down at city hall hitting you with ever more strict rules regarding how many kids are allowed to get pancaked on a given day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849284/750f9315199ed50d8eea64c2591b0c6ee451212c.gif[/img]

5 days a week for 5 weeks. As you progress through the 25 level campaign you will face ever-worsening traffic conditions and environmental hazards. Your score is determined by speed, crossing-combos, and of course how many kids you manage to get across the street. Refine your strategy for each level for better scores and reach for the top spot on the online leaderboards.

Crossing Guard Joe will be releasing on Steam in Late 2021, for Windows.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1701950/Crossing_Guard_Joe/

notes.title: THE BIG BIRTHDAY UPDATE

Stilt Fella has had a good first year on Steam and now we're bringing you free new content with THE BIG BIRTHDAY UPDATE!

[previewyoutube=uVU4vkXVpAI;full][/previewyoutube]

This update introduces three new game modes:

[b]Rocket Fella[/b]
A more accessible style of gameplay for new players, featuring remixed levels to give old players a new challenge.

[b]Fellavision[/b]
For the first time you'll be able to see THROUGH THE EYES OF STILT FELLA.

[b]Fella[/b]
A mode where you're just a fella.

The new game modes will unlock as you play through the main campaign.

The update also features:
5 new extra levels.
New clothing items.
A bunch of bug fixes and tweaks.

Hope you enjoy the new update, and let us know in the Steam Forum if you find any bugs!

notes.title: Stilt Fella Has Launched!
notes.content:
The big day is finally here. Stilt Fella is now something you can actually buy and enjoy on Steam!

I want to give a big thank you to my beta testers and everyone who played and gave me feedback on the game during the past year. Also a big thanks to everyone who played the old 2015 version of the game. It has been a long journey to this new version of Stilt Fella, but I am proud of the end result.

[b]Players![/b]

To those of you who have been following the development on [url=https://twitter.com/SeptemberGames]@SeptemberGames twitter[/url], thank you for the likes, RTs, comments and wishlistings! If you're planning on picking the game up, now's a good time as it'll be discounted -15% in the first week.

If you have any feedback or encounter any bugs, do not hesitate to let me know in the Bug Reports section of the Steam forum. And please leave a review, it'll help my tiny game get noticed by the almighty Steam Algorithm!

[b]Streamers![/b]

Are you a streamer with a decent-sized audience and you want to cover the game? Request a key via Keymailer, using this link: [url=https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/87339]keymailer.co/g/games/87339[/url]

Again, thanks for paying attention to my little game. I am excited to see where it goes.

-Henrik
